figures.shows: The 64 by 64 image the triangle test renders: a red triangle on the blue clear color, with the two pixels the test reads marked
figures.caption: The triangle covers the upper half of the image only where it narrows to its tip; the test reads one pixel inside it and one below it.
figures.alt: A square image with a blue background and a red triangle whose base lies on the horizontal middle line and whose tip touches the top edge. Two marked pixels sit on the vertical middle line: one inside the triangle, labelled red, and one in the lower half, labelled blue.
figures.numbers: Image 64 x 64 pixels. Triangle corners at pixels (0, 32), (64, 32), (32, 0). Marked pixels (32, 16), red 255 0 0 255, and (32, 48), blue 0 0 255 255.

figures.shows: The 64 by 64 image the checker shader renders: eight by eight cells in four colors, with the five pixels the test reads marked
figures.caption: Green in the upper half shows that V grows downwards; the checker parity shows that the cell index follows the texture coordinates.
figures.alt: A square image of eight by eight cells. The upper four rows alternate yellow and green; the lower four rows alternate red and black. Five pixels are marked: two in the top row, two in the seventh row and one in the last cell.
figures.numbers: Image 64 x 64 pixels, cells of 8 pixels. Marked pixels: (4, 4) yellow, (12, 4) green, (4, 52) red, (12, 52) black, (60, 60) red.
